findings.issue: The outer exception redaction does not protect logs emitted inside run_pipeline. For example, generate_questions logs the first 50 characters of the uploaded note when the provider returns a JSON wrapper; law-citation and retrieval degradation also log note/result text. The new privacy tests stub the entire pipeline, so issue #4's ordinary-log privacy acceptance is not satisfied. Apply request-scoped redaction to nested Web processing logs while preserving CLI diagnostics, and test the real pipeline.

The AnyIO-parametrized concurrency test uses asyncio.gather. With Trio installed, the default test suite fails on the trio case before testing isolation (RuntimeError: There is no current event loop). Use an AnyIO task group without excluding a backend or weakening the isolation assertions.

summary: Fixed both findings: nested Web processing logs now use request-scoped redaction while concurrent CLI diagnostics remain intact, and the concurrency test uses backend-neutral AnyIO tasks. Regression tests failed before the fix (7 failed, 1 passed); the full Python 3.11 offline suite now reports 935 passed, 1 skipped, 12 deselected, with exit 0, and the deselection gate passes. Hosted CI and the post-merge 50-persona audit remain outstanding; the pre-existing main-branch datetime.utcnow deprecation failure on Python 3.13 was not changed.
